title: Happy home life, her mother at home and trips to Churchill Downs
summary: Her mother stayed home and spoiled her with sherbet, popcorn and taffy. The family lived near Churchill Downs and went to the races together, and she never heard her parents argue.

blocks.x: While he was a lawyer, and also you said he went into real estate, he must have done alot of studying at night then, I suppose, because your mother didn't work.

She stayed home and pitted me. She used to get up and she'd say, come on lazy. It's be summertime, you know, and she said, baby I got us some sherbert made and you could come on and get some, or if it's too hot. So I'd get up. And then in the winter time we used to pop corn, make candy, make the best candy. We'd make taffy, you know, and we'd be pulling candy. We were entertaining ourselves.
That's why you people were so close, isn't it?
It was the three of you.
And then after I left home I used to come home every year, two or three times a year, so I could take Mama to play bingo. We'd go to the races. We lived, you know, just a couple of blocks from the

So we just enjoyed ourselves. I guess I had an unusual home life because we were just so happy. And I never heard my mother and father argue. The first time I heard my father curse, he was in the hospital, after I put him in this hospital, and one of the male nurses came out and they tried to make him do something. Papa said, 'what damn man nurses - tend to his business'. And that's the first time I heard him curse.
Did he ever go to the races with you?
Oh yes, he used to go. But sometimes we'd run off on him there because we didn't know he was going to be there, you know. And I'd be walking around down there and I'd run into Papa.
So this is how you got your little taste for the races.
Yeah. We were just into it ourselves.
